stock.description: Sino-Entertainment Technology Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, with its core business centered on creating and distributing mobile games across the Chinese market. The firm particularly focuses on developing titles within the role-playing and casual game genres. Beyond its primary gaming ventures, the company also engages in the development and sale of customized software and games. Its business scope further extends to the trade of computers, peripheral devices, and various electronic products, in addition to offering general software development services. Established in 2014, Sino-Entertainment Technology Holdings Limited maintains its base of operations in Hechi, China.
